title: Codename: Abandoned
tagline: Codename: Abandoned" – An immersive cyberpunk virtual tour powered by 3DVista, Web3 wallet authentication, and AI-driven NPCs. Explore eerie abandoned worlds, unlock cryptic clues from a ghostly guide, and dive into a unique fusion of blockchain tech & interactive storytelling.
description: Codename: Abandoned" is an immersive, interactive cyberpunk virtual tour that combines 360° panoramic environments, Web3 authentication, and AI-driven NPC interactions to create a unique digital exploration experience. The project is built using 3DVista, a powerful virtual tour engine, and integrates Ethereum-based wallet authentication to provide users with gated access to different areas within the virtual world. Additionally, an AI-powered ghost NPC offers cryptic clues and narrative elements, enhancing the storytelling aspect for a true AI agentic experience.
how_its_made:
Built using 3DVista (virtual tour engine) and Three.js (WebGL rendering). Ethereum authentication (personal_sign) ensures decentralized access. AI NPCs generate unique dialogues via local AI models (future IPFS-based memory storage planned). Designed for autonomous, on-chain extensibility.
Gasless authentication via personal_sign keeps entry frictionless. AI NPCs could evolve via decentralized storage (future upgrade). Panorama rendering is fully immersive, with adaptive UI fixes for fullscreen bugs. Designed for cross-dApp interaction, ensuring modular expansion.
